name: ConditionalSplitNode
label: Conditional Split
description: Routes each row of a data table into one of several output data tables based on a semicolon-separated list of DataTable row filter expressions. The first matching condition wins per row; rows matching no condition go to a default output.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table to route rows from.

fields.name: FilterExpressions
fields.label: Filter Expressions
fields.description: Semicolon-separated row filter expressions, e.g. "Age > 18; Age <= 18". The first matching condition wins per row.

fields.name: OutputNames
fields.label: Output Names
fields.description: Semicolon-separated names for each output data table, e.g. "Adults;Minors". Must match the number of filter expressions.

fields.name: DefaultOutputName
fields.label: Default Output Name
fields.description: The name of the output that receives rows matching no condition. Defaults to 'Default'.

fields.name: Outputs
fields.label: Outputs
fields.description: A dictionary mapping output names to the routed DataTable instances.
